record.original_question: Let alpha be a big cohomology class on a compact Kahler manifold, let theta be a smooth closed representative of alpha, and let V_theta be the theta-plurisubharmonic function with minimal singularities. Determine whether the polar locus P(alpha) = {x : V_theta(x) = -infinity} always coincides with the non-bounded locus NB(alpha) = {x : V_theta is not locally bounded near x}.

evidence.quote: Question 42 (Eyssidieux-Guedj-Zeriahi). Does P(alpha) always coincide with NB(alpha) ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold and let $\alpha \in H^{1,1}(X,\mathbb{R})$ be a big cohomology class, i.e., $\alpha$ contains a Kähler current. Fix a smooth closed real $(1,1)$-form $\theta$ representing $\alpha$. A function $\varphi \colon X \to [-\infty,\infty)$ is called $\theta$-plurisubharmonic ($\theta$-psh) if it is upper semicontinuous, locally integrable, and satisfies $\theta + dd^c \varphi \geq 0$ in the sense of currents. Among $\theta$-psh functions, one says that $V_\theta$ has minimal singularities if $V_\theta$ is $\theta$-psh and for every other $\theta$-psh function $\varphi$ on $X$ there exists a constant $C$ with $\varphi \leq V_\theta + C$; the canonical choice is
$$V_\theta(x) = \sup\{\varphi(x) : \varphi \text{ is } \theta\text{-psh on } X,\ \varphi \leq 0\}.$$
Define the polar locus and the non-bounded locus of $\alpha$ by
$$P(\alpha) = \{x \in X : V_\theta(x) = -\infty\}, \qquad NB(\alpha) = \{x \in X : V_\theta \text{ is not locally bounded near } x\}.$$
(These sets are independent of the choice of smooth representative $\theta$ and of the particular envelope with minimal singularities, up to behaviour determined by $\alpha$.) Determine whether the equality $P(\alpha) = NB(\alpha)$ holds for every big class $\alpha$ on every compact Kähler manifold $X$.
artifact.status_search_result: A direct web search did not surface a published resolution of the question whether $P(\alpha) = NB(\alpha)$ for every big class on a compact Kähler manifold. The framework comes from work of Boucksom–Eyssidieux–Guedj–Zeriahi on Monge–Ampère equations in big cohomology classes, where the inclusion $NB(\alpha) \subseteq P(\alpha)$ is standard but the reverse inclusion is not known to hold in general. No source found explicitly confirms or refutes the equality, so the status is recorded as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Monge–Ampère equations in big cohomology classes
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational paper of Boucksom–Eyssidieux–Guedj–Zeriahi developing pluripotential theory and minimal-singularity envelopes V_theta in big cohomology classes on compact Kähler manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the framework (envelopes with minimal singularities, ample locus, non-pluripolar products) in which the polar locus P(alpha) and non-bounded locus NB(alpha) are defined; equality of these loci is not asserted in general.

status_evidence.title: On metrics with minimal singularities of line bundles whose stable base loci admit holomorphic tubular neighborhoods
status_evidence.snippet: Studies minimal singularities of metrics in special geometric situations.
status_evidence.claim: Treats only special cases where minimal-singularity behaviour can be analyzed; does not establish the general equality P(alpha) = NB(alpha).
